nonce.description: Nonce that must be included in the signed challenge

message.description: Exact message payload that the wallet should sign

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the challenge expires

post.description:

Requires session_token cookie. If you've logged in, this cookie is already set in your browser.

parameters.name: Cookie
parameters.description: Active session cookie (automatically included after login)

feePercentage.description: Fee percentage (e.g., '1' = 1%, '2.5' = 2.5%). If set to '0', allows API request fees to take precedence. If set to any other value, overrides any fee passed via API.

feeAddress.description: Wallet address to receive fees. Required if feePercentage is set.

operatorWalletAddress.description: Wallet address that will act as operator for commerce payments. The API operator wallet will execute transactions on behalf of this address. Can be a smart wallet that has granted permissions to the API operator.

defaultPreApprovalExpiry.description: Default pre-approval expiry duration in seconds for commerce transactions. If set, overrides the value passed in /v2/commerce-payments/authorize/calldata endpoint.

defaultAuthorizationExpiry.description: Default authorization expiry duration in seconds for commerce transactions. If set, overrides the value passed in /v2/commerce-payments/authorize/calldata endpoint.

payeeDestinationId.description: Destination ID to bind this client ID to. When set, secure payments created with this client ID can only target this destination. Format: ERC-7828 payee address + token address.

get.description:
Checks whether a link-intent access token exists, is unused, and is unexpired. Requires an authenticated session. Returns 200 when valid, including the intent's `clientIdName` and the orchestrator's branding when configured; otherwise throws (404 unknown token, 403 used/expired) with a `code` in the body.

Requires session_token cookie. If you've logged in, this cookie is already set in your browser.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The link-intent access token

parameters.name: Cookie
parameters.description: Active session cookie (automatically included after login)

403.description: Used or expired token (code: LINK_INTENT_USED | LINK_INTENT_EXPIRED)

post.description:
Mints a client ID owned by the authenticated wallet session under the intent's name and links it to the intent's orchestrator, then marks the token used. Intents without an orchestrator KYT plan require `kyt.provider` to be Hypernative, Merkle Science, or null for KYT off. Requires a wallet session. Throws (404 unknown token, 403 used/expired) with a `code` in the body.

Requires session_token cookie. If you've logged in, this cookie is already set in your browser.
